subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘NORMAL’ is written as ‘DIPKRO’ and ‘SOUND’ is written as ‘GKRPX’. How will ‘CLUSTER’ be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

**Logic: Step 1: Alphabet are arranged in alphabetical order.**

**Step 2: Addition and subtraction of 3 in alternate manner.**

‘NORMAL’ is written as ‘DIPKRO’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07b71e06863b6d681b85fc235bb75c3248721b19db84c593cf50f5d32446683c.png] 

And,

‘SOUND’ is written as ‘GKRPX

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9a4c362f278120a8df0a42fb79d09196c910e0fb1aa565efb0d2bac7a1f0d5.png] 

Similarly,

‘CLUSTER’ is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67eafe8336e7d9fe08aaa58780adc1ccc568efa5ea2bf0bed5664e012eec97f4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"FBOOVQX".**
